## Comparability caveat

Alaska Air Group's FY2024 figures are **not on a like-for-like basis** with the other four carriers. Alaska completed its acquisition of Hawaiian Holdings on September 18, 2024, and Hawaiian's results are consolidated only from that date forward [DOC-2]. Alaska's FY2024 therefore blends ~8.5 months of standalone Alaska with ~3.5 months of the combined entity (Hawaiian contributed $869M of revenue and a $113M net loss in that stub period) [DOC-2]. Its cost ratios are a partial-year mix, and they are not comparable either to Alaska's own prior-year ratios or, strictly, to the full-year single-entity ratios of Delta, United, Southwest, and American. All five companies are otherwise on the same calendar fiscal year (Jan 1 – Dec 31) [DOC-1].

## Aircraft fuel expense as % of revenue, FY2024 (lowest first)

| Rank | Airline | Fuel / Revenue | Calculation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Delta | **17.1%** | $10,566M / $61,643M [DOC-1] |
| 2 | United | **20.6%** | $11,756M / $57,063M [DOC-1] |
| 3 | American | **21.1%** | $11,418M / $54,211M [DOC-1] |
| 4 | Southwest | **21.1%** | $5,812M / $27,483M [DOC-1] |
| 5 | Alaska | **21.4%** | $2,506M / $11,735M [DOC-1] |

American (21.06%) and Southwest (21.15%) are separated by less than 0.1 percentage point — effectively a tie.

## Salaries, wages and benefits as % of revenue, FY2024 (lowest first)

| Rank | Airline | SW&B / Revenue | Calculation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Delta | **26.2%** | $16,161M / $61,643M [DOC-1] |
| 2 | United | **29.2%** | $16,678M / $57,063M [DOC-1] |
| 3 | American | **29.6%** | $16,021M / $54,211M [DOC-1] |
| 4 | Alaska | **30.6%** | $3,588M / $11,735M [DOC-1] |
| 5 | Southwest | **44.5%** | $12,240M / $27,483M [DOC-1] |

## Conclusion

Yes — **Delta ranks first (lowest) on both metrics**, at 17.1% fuel-to-revenue and 26.2% labor-to-revenue, reflecting the largest revenue base of the group ($61,643M) and the highest operating income ($5,995M) [DOC-1]. The top two positions are identical in both rankings (Delta, then United); the orderings diverge only in the lower half, where Southwest swings from 4th on fuel to a distant 5th on labor.

ANSWER: Fuel % of revenue (lowest first): Delta 17.1%, United 20.6%, American 21.1%, Southwest 21.1%, Alaska 21.4%. Salaries/wages/benefits % of revenue (lowest first): Delta 26.2%, United 29.2%, American 29.6%, Alaska 30.6%, Southwest 44.5%. Yes — Delta is top-ranked (lowest) in both, though Alaska's ratios are not strictly comparable because of the mid-year (Sept 18, 2024) Hawaiian acquisition.
